items.title: Cockerel, your personal assistant
items.text: Ask him to research anything on the web and he sends the write-up to your Nest as a file. He asks first before he emails, restarts something or repeats a job, and he can read your calendar and unread email, but never change them.

items.title: His notebook and morning brief
items.text: He remembers what you tell him, keeps your tasks, sets reminders that buzz your phone, and can send a short brief each morning. You can see and edit all of it, and switch any tool off in Admin.
